name: Planner local transients + stable manifest + deterministic shortId
description:
Reduce cross-worktree git churn and merge conflicts caused by planner-derived files being written inside the tracked `.planner/` tree.

Background: when two agents work on the same project in different git worktrees (e.g. `~/projects/myvim` on F004 and `/Users/antonio/projects/heca` on F009), the planner writes shared/derived files (`manifest.json`, `*.bak`, `generated/`, `resume.json`, `activity.json`, `handoff-archive/`) directly into `.planner/`. These files are tracked by git and change on every planner operation, producing large diffs and inevitable merge conflicts on unrelated feature branches.

Goals:
1. Isolate all transient/session-local/derived artifacts under `.planner/.local/` (gitignored) so they never appear in `git status` or cause merge conflicts.
2. Make `manifest.json` stable by removing its frequently-updated `updatedAt` field; move the timestamp to `.planner/.local/timestamp.json`.
3. Move atomic-write crash backups from `<file>.bak` next to source files into `.planner/.local/backups/<relative-path>/<file>.bak`.
4. Move `generated/` markdown views from `.planner/generated/` to `.planner/.local/generated/`.
5. Move `resume.json`, `activity.json`, and `handoff-archive/` into `.planner/.local/`.
6. Make `shortId` generation deterministic for existing entities so two worktrees starting from the same commit produce identical shortIds, avoiding content conflicts during schema backfill.
7. Reduce unnecessary I/O in `writeGenerated()` by comparing new content with existing content before writing.

Out of scope:
- Multi-root server / single UI for multiple worktrees (will be handled separately).
- Changing how source entity files (`features/*.json`, `phases/*.json`, `project.json`, `requirements.json`) are stored.

Implementation notes:
- Path helpers in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` are the central place to update (`manifestPath`, `generatedDir`, `resumePath`, `activityPath`, `handoffArchiveDir`, and the backup logic in `atomicWriteText`).
- `ManifestSchema` may keep `updatedAt` for backward compat but PlanStore will read/write it from the timestamp file.
- `createShortId` in `packages/plan-core/src/naming.ts` needs an optional `seed` parameter used during backfill.
- `ensureShortIdsAndPriority` in `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` seeds shortIds from stable entity identifiers (`feature:${number}:${id}`, etc.).
- Web UI and server static serving need to read `generated/` from the new `.local/generated/` path.
- The `.gitignore` written by `PlanStore.init()` already ignores `*.bak`, `generated/`, `resume.json`, etc.; it must be updated to cover `.local/` generically.

Affected packages: `@agent-plan/core`, `@agent-plan/server`, `@agent-plan/web-ui`, `@agent-plan/pi-adapter` (static dir resolution), `@agent-plan/mcp` (if it references paths).

Acceptance criteria:
- After loading the planner in two clean worktrees from the same commit, `git status` shows no changes in `.planner/` from transient files.
- `manifest.json` is unchanged after normal planner operations.
- `.planner/.local/` exists and contains timestamp, backups, generated, resume, activity, handoff-archive.
- Two worktrees produce identical `shortId` values for the same entities after `ensureShortIdsAndPriority()`.
- Build and type-check pass across the monorepo.
- Web UI still serves correctly from the relocated generated bundle.
